holidays.name: Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.

note: Calendar data only, not a legal interpretation: the standard United States federal holiday list that the counting rules reference when they say a period continues past a legal holiday. Weekday numbers use the Python convention, Monday is 0 through Sunday is 6. Observed-day shifting when a holiday falls on a weekend is not encoded here; the verify-against-local-rules warning covers that check.
source: Federal holidays, 5 U.S.C. section 6103, as listed by the U.S. Office of Personnel Management
